implementation: Original source native scan codec/dispatch/SDIO observation contract; no itlwm or Apple implementation code copied.

reference_source.credit: OpenIntelWireless/itlwm contributors; original reference license retained with reference artifacts.
reference_source.scope: Third-party native producer/source corroboration; not a standalone claim of iOS private ABI compatibility.

ios_evidence.crosscheck: Direct SET10/5456 GET11/1164; exact result offsets match mac12+ inlineIE1024. Donor REA proves consumer offsets/end/event; source corroborates scan enum, nested channel version1, band0x8, age ms. Rates copy loop precedes count assignment and does NOT prove rate conversion.

request_dictionary_default.contract: Accept only the two observed defaults; identity of CFString option key not assumed. Other bits/filters still rejected. Backend modes/generation/result/complete unchanged.
request_dictionary_default.current_boot: kernel7d3/device565 has real14AP then SET10/5456 errno102; request payload not observed, no sole-cause assertion.
request_dictionary_default.tests: test_native_scan_results.py donor defaults + 261510 carriers; actual dispatch callbacks/errors/generation and no cached RF

notes: Production A04BR3NativeRendezvous uses A04BR3NativeScanAdapter -> actual SDIO snapshot/copy_record and scan_mode(service,active,&acceptedGeneration); API1 required at compile time, no fallback.
Optional native ratecount0 until integerMbps conversion is proven; received raw rate IEs retained byte-for-byte and crosschecked with actual AP metadata. No fabricated rate values.
Only observed 2GHz flag0x8. Nested channel version1. No inferred bandwidth/ACTIVE/DFS flags. Noise/SNR gate0 (not measured); RSSI requires real valid RCPI, never zero substituted.
Full actual IEs retained; >1024 returns EMSGSIZE with no truncation. Actual observation time to current same-clock us determines AGE milliseconds. Missing/invalid observation returns error.

Normal type1 active and type2 passive call distinct real mode requests with generation accepted under SDIO lock; type3 cached never starts RF. Actual backend AIS/regulatory policy and errno remain authoritative.
Actual producer record allocated off kernel stack; generation rechecked around copy. Iterator EAGAIN/ESTALE/EIO semantics preserve outputs on errors; no repeated AP0.
Real completion uses observed complete generation, reserve/ack around DLIL posting; fresh SET returns EBUSY during publication to avoid old completion satisfying new request.
Native BSD gate logs at most32 requests boot-wide using real OSAtomic CAS saturating budget. Only type/value/request-length/errno; no payload/address/password/MAC.
Actual SDK/hardware classification/scan/socket delivery unverified for this patch; parent owns builds/flash.
